prompt:
Research what the Home Assistant project has officially published about the number of active installations (its opt-in analytics). Cite the page and quote the numbers.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

If you're not sure about something, just say so.

response.content:
Based on the provided web search results, the Home Assistant project has published several official figures and estimates regarding its number of active installations and the opt-in analytics program.

The most recent and definitive figure comes from the State of the Open Home 2025 event, which announced a major milestone.

SOURCE: https://www.home-assistant.io/blog/2025/04/16/state-of-the-open-home-recap/ | QUOTE: "One big announcement Franck made was that this year we went from 1 million to over 2 million active installations in 2024!" | CLAIM: There were over 2 million active Home Assistant installations in 2024.

Other sources provide context about the analytics program itself, its opt-in nature, and how the total user base is estimated from the number of users who share analytics.

SOURCE: https://analytics.home-assistant.io/ | QUOTE: "695,026 Active Home Assistant Installations" | CLAIM: As of the time that analytics page was accessed, there were 695,026 installations opted into analytics.
SOURCE: https://analytics.home-assistant.io/ | QUOTE: "We estimate that less than a fourth of all Home Assistant users opt in." | CLAIM: The Home Assistant project estimates that the number of users who opt into analytics represents less than 25% of the total user base.
SOURCE: https://www.home-assistant.io/blog/2021/11/12/100k-analytics/ | QUOTE: "Our estimate is that there are 4-5x more installations than people that opt-in to analytics." | CLAIM: The project historically estimated the total number of installations to be 4 to 5 times the number of installations opted into analytics.
SOURCE: https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/analytics/ | QUOTE: "The Analytics system was introduced in Home Assistant 2021.4, and it's used by 76.5% of the active installations." | CLAIM: At the time that integration page was written, 76.5% of active installations had opted into analytics. (Note: This percentage appears to be from an earlier snapshot in time and conflicts with the "less than a fourth" estimate from the main analytics page, highlighting that the opt-in rate has changed over time).
SOURCE: https://analytics.home-assistant.io/statistics/ | QUOTE: "496,813 of 637,194 (77.97%) installations have chosen to share usage statistics" | CLAIM: At the time that statistics page was accessed, 77.97% of the installations tracked by the analytics system had opted to share data.

NO_SOURCE_FOUND: A more recent, specific number for the current count of installations opted into analytics (beyond the 695k figure). The 2 million total figure is the most recent official number published.
